cultures.name: The briefing
cultures.public_fact: The Civic Super Task Force exists to give the city a registered, deployable team and to stay deliberately less powerful than Enforcer apex. The motto is Sanctioned. Equipped. Accountable. The sheet allies the Force with Luminary Industries and with the Baseline Resistance, and it rivals the Enforcers and the Crimson Spire. Reputation on the sheet is 64. Commander Vale was a prosecutor who emerged with kinetic-cascade powers in her thirties and built the Force as an alternative to the Movement. The backstory states that she accepts off-books Luminary funding so the Force is not defunded. The currency is a civic writ, and this slice pays none.
cultures.identity: A municipal identity is a morning briefing on an anchor 10 m inside its capital, and a wage line the player can be told exists without being walked to a dining room that has no coordinate. The press culture of the city is heard here as two headlines that are already lore: the first film, which the press could not file as hero or as vigilante, and the morning after the forty-three-minute rooftop, which split the same way. Neither headline is Mira's unpublished page.
cultures.stops_before: The contingency journal, the 18–22 dining block, a firearm mesh, a kinetic aura, and any edit to reputation 64.

cultures.name: The storefront
cultures.public_fact: The Movement for Emerged Civil Rights says the substrate chose, and the people did not. The motto is We did not choose this. The substrate did. The goal is full civil rights, resistance to the Registration Act, alliances with sympathetic normie residents, and a record of Enforcer overreach that does not become the Enforcers. Juno emerged with mid-tier sonic powers eight years ago, left corporate law, and has been arrested four times. Her power, on the sheet, is enough to be heard and modest enough not to read as a threat. Reputation is 60. The currency is a movement token, and this slice pays none.
cultures.identity: A storefront identity is a legal morning and an evening meeting on a pin 10 m inside the rights capital, with the clinic district named and unplaced. The overlap 9.34 m away is an argument S15 already walks. Documentation happens in the office the map has, and in a clinic the map does not.
cultures.stops_before: The locked negotiation journal, the afternoon varies block, a fifth arrest, a passed or killed Act, and a sonic ring on the body.

cultures.name: The headquarters
cultures.public_fact: The Baseline Resistance says they were the city before the powers. The motto is We were the city before they were powers. The goal is to resist bio-powered dominance, to pass the Registration Act, and to protect normie citizens from collateral in super-on-super fights. Devon Cross has led for four years. He is a normie. He has pushed the Act since his sister was killed in a 2090 crossfire. A draft of the Act is in his gear. Reputation is 53. The currency is a baseline chit, and this slice pays none. The allied list on the Task Force sheet includes this faction. The rival list here includes the Enforcers, the Spire, and the rights movement.
cultures.identity: A headquarters identity is a lobbying morning on a pin 10 m inside the Baseline capital, a draft that is paper, and a vote that has not been taken. The civic meeting house and the council chambers are district or schedule strings without anchors. The courier who shares the given name Devon is a different id and a different room.
cultures.stops_before: The son's name, the disclosure journal, a vote, a walk of the 9.09 m overlap, and a merge with walker_bullet.

cultures.name: Spires and the street
cultures.where: College capital, empty campus anchor, empty grid anchor, the 13.62 m gap as a witness, unplaced kit sets
cultures.public_fact: WorldDef fantasy is height as verb. Traversal is a vertical city. The kit says the ground floor stays the culture and an upper retrofit must not erase the marble silhouette. Palette is marble, gold daylight, and one blue: #d8d4dc, #ffd0a0, #3a78ff, with #c8a060 on the kit. Ground in Canon is #4a5870. Sun is #ffd0a0. The College is the far rim, about 81.5 m, and its campus anchor is empty of this facet. Luminary's public motto on the grid anchor is Order. Progress. Light. Reputation there is 91. The public works are orphanage funding, infrastructure, and disaster relief. The only street S15 allowed a creature is the gap between Baseline and the Spire.
cultures.identity: A vertical identity is three sentences a person can walk: a municipal capital 10 m from its HQ, a college capital whose office string is a different room, and a gap of 13.62 m that is street because neither circle covers it. Launch pads, the mercy spire, and the bread kitchen stay kit names until someone places them. The Hub Present at (0, -220) is the spoke, not a fourth spire.
cultures.stops_before: Placing roof_pad, aegis_spire, or street_kitchen; publishing Aldis's rate; stating the planned accident or the swarm authorization; recounting the eleven; taking a spire chit.

desks.practice: A morning press briefing is the satisfaction method on her civic_legitimacy need. She files the Force in public as sanctioned, equipped, and accountable, and as deliberately less powerful than Enforcer apex. The three fears on the faction sheet are speakable: the Enforcers taking the headline on a bust, a member going to the criminal supers, the city defunding the Force after the next civilian deaths. She does not itemize the wage. The sheet says 580 diurnal sparks from city_payroll_plus_off_books_luminary and lists 22 civic writs on her person. This facet pays none of them and does not split 580 into a city figure and a Luminary figure.

Morning legal strategy is the satisfaction method on registration_act_defeat. The public file has two columns the country map can answer: a district name, and whether countries.json gave that name an anchor. The storefront is a yes. civil_rights_legal_clinic is a controlled district and a no. Documentation discipline is the value. Becoming the Enforcers is the failure the goal already names. Her sheet says 220 diurnal sparks from movement_pooled_donations and lists 24 movement tokens. This facet pays none.

Morning lobbying calls are the satisfaction method on registration_act_passage. The draft in his gear is one sheet of paper. The vote is not on the clock. He can say the sister, the year 2090, and four years of leadership. He can say the three public fears that circle the same vote: the Task Force fears voting yes and then owning the next casualty, the rights movement fears the Task Force voting yes, the Baseline fears the Task Force voting no. His sheet says 160 diurnal sparks from resistance_pooled_donations and lists 18 baseline chits. This facet pays none. He does not discuss the house.

purse_rule: Inventory counts 22, 24, and 18, wages 580, 220, and 160, and starting_sparks 14000, 3200, and 1800 are canon sheet seeds. They are not a shop, not a loot table, and not a second wallet. q_s16_three_purses has each lead name their own wage and their own currency count. No object moves.

encounters_politics.what: One commander. The mandate is less than apex. Two headlines can be written. The grid motto can be fetched. The three heights can be walked. No writ is paid.
One advocate. Four arrests on the record. The clinic district has no pin. The overlap 9.34 m away stays S15's.
One normie lead. A draft is on the desk. A vote is not taken. The Baseline capital 10 m away keeps the S15 mystic and the Act errand.
The motto, the reputation number 91, and the three public works. 8.03 m from the arterial. No drone, no Vesper, no chief of staff, no recount of the eleven.
The campus anchor, 10 m from the college capital. The motto Your power is a discipline. Train it. No dean, no student, no doubled rate.
The board of notice_two_faces. Vale is off the anchor. Spawn count 0.

side_quests.title: Municipal Anchor — Less Than Apex

objectives.text: At (-14.87, 29.22), ask what the Force is for. She will say a registered team, deliberately less powerful than Enforcer apex, sent after criminal supers without provoking the Enforcers' Movement. She will say the motto. She will not open the contingency journal.
Walk the 10 m to the Task Force capital at (-22.87, 35.22). It is a claim, 41.99 m from the Dawn-local origin. Leave Flower Law on the Hub. Write that the HQ sits inside the circle.
She may say the city payroll is not the only wage line on her sheet. Do not ask to attend the 18–22 dining block. That room has no coordinate.
Bring back the mandate: sanctioned, less than apex, dinner unattended. She does not pay a civic writ.

fail: Follow her to a dining room
Bind a pistol or a cascade aura
Flower the capital because the radius number matches 42
Spawn a drone to show the fear of a casualty event

world_hooks.board_line: Registered. Less than apex. The dinner was not attended.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Vale kept the briefing and kept the journal shut.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: Municipal anchor. No training-facility mesh is built.

side_quests.title: Municipal Anchor — Two Headlines
side_quests.giver_spawn: presence_vale_briefing. Clock 8–12. The evening board is a separate notice and is not required.

objectives.text: Ask what the press did with the first film. The public sentence is that the city had a first hero, most people loved him, and the press could not decide hero or vigilante. Do not stand Elias. His training room has no anchor.
Write the second headline from the same briefing: forty-three minutes, both walked away, two blocks did not, Luminary called it unprovoked, the neighborhood called it two faces, neither side won.
Stay on the municipal anchor. The battle roof, the news office, and Kane Tower have no pins. Do not place aegis_spire to host the sentence.
Turn the two headlines in as public culture. Mira's page stays off any front this errand controls, because this errand never reaches her desk.

Treat the evening notice as a second quest reward

world_hooks.board_line: Hero or vigilante, unprovoked or two faces. Neither headline finished the morning.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: The briefing kept both sentences and added no third.

objectives.text: At the HQ, ask which claim is a spire and which open is a street. She will send you to three checks and will not hand you a roof.
Stand at (-22.87, 35.22). Write: municipal spire-claim, HQ 10 m inside, Flower Law elsewhere.

Walk to the campus anchor at (59.16, 16.78), 10 m from the college capital. The capital-to-capital distance from the Task Force is the 75.07 m S15 published. The anchor is empty. Write the college motto. Do not enter a dean's office. Do not publish a rate.

Reach the gap midpoint (-4.4, -37.7), 67.73 m from the HQ. Write: 13.62 m of street, uncovered by either radius. If the jackals are up, stop the nip and leave the chips. Do not continue to the Spire gate. That continuation is q_s15_spire_gap.
Return the three sentences. She does not place a launch pad, a mercy spire, or a street kitchen to make the lesson prettier.

fail: Walk on to the Spire gate and turn the errand into q_s15_spire_gap
Add a kestrel to the campus

world_hooks.board_line: Municipal claim, empty campus, 13.62 m of street.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Height stayed a verb. Nobody won a roof.

side_quests.title: Grid Anchor — The Public Face

objectives.text: Ask what Luminary says in public. She is allied to that faction on her sheet. She will say the motto and the three works, and she will not send you into a tower.
Stand at (-36.76, 13.93). You are inside the Luminary circle and inside the Enforcers' circle. Write Order. Progress. Light. Write reputation 91 as a sheet number, not a score you change.
The arterial is 8.03 m away. Do not walk it for this errand. The eleven already have q_s15_eleven_stand. Spawn nothing on either pin.
Bring the motto back. Kane Tower, the financial arc, and the orbital facility stay unplaced. The planned accident stays unspoken.

fail: State that the accident was planned
Spawn a drone or a sentinel

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: The public face was copied and the nest stayed empty.

side_quests.title: Storefront — Four Arrests

objectives.text: At (-47.95, -16.88), ask for the public record of the lead. She will say eight years since emergence, a corporate-law career left behind, and four arrests. She will not open the negotiation journal.
Write four. The motto stays We did not choose this. The substrate did. Do not add a charge.
Walk the 10 m to the rights capital at (-55.95, -10.88). Do not speak for her. Do not continue into the overlap. That walk is q_s15_act_unpassed.
Return the count to the storefront. The Act is still unpassed. No movement token is paid.

fail: Speak for Juno on the overlap

world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Juno kept the count and kept the journal locked.

side_quests.title: Storefront — The Clinic Has No Pin

objectives.text: Ask where the documentation is filed. She will name the storefront, which you are standing in, and civil_rights_legal_clinic, which is a controlled district with no anchor in countries.json.
Confirm the breakroom string is not a second map pin. Between 12 and 14 she is not on this anchor. Do not invent a lunchroom transform to keep her visible.

Stay on (-47.95, -16.88). The overlap midpoint is 9.34 m away. Leave it to the Act errand. Write that documentation of overreach, the faction goal, happens in a room the country file did not place, and that becoming the Enforcers is the failure the values already name.
Turn in the missing pin as a missing pin. Do not build the clinic.

fail: Walk the overlap and call it this quest
Stand an Enforcer on the storefront

world_hooks.board_line: Clinic district named. No anchor. Storefront remains the pin.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: The record kept a hole in the map instead of filling it.

side_quests.title: Headquarters — Draft, Not a Vote

objectives.text: At (-26.07, -46.6), ask why the Act is his morning. He will say he has led for four years, that he is a normie, and that he has pushed the Act since his sister was killed in a 2090 super-on-super crossfire. He will not discuss anyone in the house.
See that a draft is in his gear. A draft is paper. Do not call a vote. Do not open the disclosure journal.
Walk the 10 m to the Baseline capital at (-34.07, -40.6). The S15 mystic may be there. Do not take their Act errand as this turn-in. Do not speak for Devon. Return.
Tell him the draft is still a draft. Council chambers and the civic meeting house have no anchors, so the afternoon lobbying is not a room you can finish. No baseline chit is paid.

fail: Stand walker_bullet and merge the name
Walk the 9.09 m overlap as this quest

world_hooks.board_line: Headquarters: the Act is a draft. The vote was not taken.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Devon kept the morning and kept the other journal shut.

side_quests.title: Three Anchors — The Purses Stay Shut
side_quests.giver_spawn: presence_vale_briefing. Clock 8–12, the only band when all three leads are on their anchors.

objectives.text: At (-14.87, 29.22), ask what the morning pays. She will say 580 diurnal sparks, source city_payroll_plus_off_books_luminary, and 22 civic writs on her person. She will not split 580. She will not hand over a writ. She will not open the contingency journal or the dining room.

At (-47.95, -16.88), while her morning window holds, ask what the storefront pays. She will say 220 diurnal sparks from movement_pooled_donations and 24 movement tokens on her person. She pays none. The negotiation journal stays locked. Do not walk the overlap.

At (-26.07, -46.6), while his morning window holds, ask what the headquarters pays. He will say 160 diurnal sparks from resistance_pooled_donations and 18 baseline chits on his person. He pays none. The draft stays paper. He does not discuss the house. Do not turn this in to the mystic 10 m away.
Return the three sentences. Legitimacy, a legal morning, and a lobbying call were the work. Coin stays 0. The sheet seeds 14000, 3200, and 1800 starting sparks are not a purse you open.

fail: Take a writ, a token, or a chit
Walk the overlap or turn in to the mystic

world_hooks.board_line: Three anchors named their purses. None of them opened.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: The morning paid attention and kept the currencies on the sheets.
world_hooks.prop_or_door: Three staffed anchors. No treasury mesh.
